newsitem.title: USA: Trion sees Q4 results below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Trion sees Q4 results below estimates.

text.p: Trion Inc said Friday it expects its earnings in the third quarter ended September 30 to fall below analysts' estimates.
During that period, the company plans to take a charge of about $400,000 for its acquisition of Hermidifier Co.
The company said it also expects its operating results will be lower than expected because a downtown in the market for microelectornics increased competition and led to lower prices and margins.
Trion did not disclose analysts' estimates. The company did not immediately return a telephone call.
In last year's third quarter, the company reported net income of $502,000, or $0.08 per share, on sales of $11.08 million.
Trion said a shift in its product mix is expected, as a major retailer pushed out the introduction of a new line of air cleaner products from this year's third quarter to the first quarter of 1997.
The resulting lower level of production, along with its inventory reduction program, is expected to lead to higher production costs for the period, it said.
Trion said it expects its earnings to improve to historic levels in all segments in the fourth quarter except for the microelectronics area, which is expected to rebound in the second half of 1997.
Trion specializes in products for indoor air quality.
